subject: Context OS gap analysis and the two campaign-critical closures
status: VERIFIED BY THE CONTROLLER. 246 passed, 0 failed (was 244). Not merged.
finding_that_shaped_the_lane: The Context Stack was already REAL_WIRED at 4,947 lines with a live compiler, index legs and memory store. This was never a build-from-nothing task, and treating it as one would have added surface to a working subsystem.

closed.why_it_was_first: Section 7.3's stated failure is 'a virtual memory system does not become a fake native context claim'. A wrong context number causes silent truncation and bad answers, so misreporting capability outranks every other gap.
closed.implementation: manifest.rs now always distinguishes native from effective, carries native_tokens explicitly, and emits the explanation 'usable context (retrieval+compaction) is not native_maximum'. The comment at line 56 names the exact confusion it exists to prevent.

New rot.rs, 352 lines. Pure and deterministic: detect_context_rot reads a compiled manifest plus optional live occupancy and returns severity, concrete signals, and meter-ready explanations. Thresholds default to matching the existing watermarks and recall floors so the two systems cannot disagree.
closed.why_it_matters: The turn loop previously had no way to notice its own context had degraded.

closed.implementation: Compiler admit path, with the host still receiving events on real degrades.

refused_correctly.gap: Validated quality context, validated agentic context, KV curve, prefill curve
refused_correctly.reason_given: Needs real calibration runs against models; inventing numbers would be the failure mode the section forbids.
refused_correctly.assessment: Right call, and the most important judgement in the lane. A constant in a config presented as a measured curve IS the fake-native-claim failure. Refusing to fabricate them is worth more than closing them wrongly.

honestly_left_open: Six memory types remain ONE store. Reported as not done rather than papered over -- 'adding labels alone is not REAL_WIRED', which is the correct standard.
RepoMap is real in the index but unwired to the compiler
Tokenizer-true allocation needs the tokenizer asset on the turn path
Copy-on-write warm forks / KV banking sit at the engine/serve seam; the host does not fork KV

test_count_discrepancy_reconciled.measured_by_controller: 213 passed 0 failed on --lib; 246 passed 0 failed on the full suite, up from 244
test_count_discrepancy_reconciled.explanation: Two causes. Scope: they ran --lib, which excludes the integration targets, hence 213 versus 246. And their 3 failures -- run_command api, service process heartbeats, write-lease revoke -- are timing-sensitive process tests that flaked under the contention of a live pack plus concurrent lanes. They do not reproduce here. No regression.

not_evidence_of: that the declared context numbers are correct -- the measurement infrastructure to validate them is exactly what was left open
